audit.recode_to: No change of kind (fixed second-syllable + even-syllable alternation, dominant, with a minority prototonic class already carried as caveat). Cell-level refinement only: the disyllable cell '01' is not supported -- Menovshchikov 1997:81 says disyllables are predominantly initial-stressed and Krauss 1985:178 n.5 says disyllable stress marks are not necessarily significant; consider '10' or flag disyllables as indeterminate.
audit.quote_check: confirmed in the copy we hold
audit.reasoning: (1) Quote check: the deciding Krauss 1985 pp.177-178 passage in the domain quotation/the domain locator is verbatim in the ERIC text we hold (cent2128/, lines 9946-9960), including the Rubtsova 1954:16 quotation; but the record's own quote/cite/loc/grade/sources fields are empty, so the evidence should be promoted from the database-check note into those fields. (2) Deciding source: a 1985 dedicated prosody chapter by Krauss (philological, from Menovshchikov's 1964 accent-marked transcriptions), corroborated by two held primary statements -- Menovshchikov 1964:107 (several equal stresses 'через слог') and Menovshchikov 1997:81 (2-4-6-8 model for the overwhelming majority, 1-3-5-7 rare, long vowel disrupts rhythm).
